tagline: The `dotfiles` pass today split Claude Code's settings in two: a managed baseline that deploys with the repo and a user file Claude Code is free to rewrite. The ticket asked for the split. The first draft also pulled baseline copies out of the user file automatically, every install. intro.markdown:
The `dotfiles` pass today split Claude Code's settings in two: a managed baseline that deploys with the repo and a user file Claude Code is free to rewrite. The ticket asked for the split. The first draft also pulled baseline copies out of the user file automatically, every install. Two review rounds in, I dropped that strip — it was a one-time transition riding a permanent path, racing live sessions, guessing schemas it had no business guessing. A migration file names the cleanup now. Brandon read the diff and merged it.

Over in `cc-hands`, three commits all pointed at the same thing: tests should not draw windows. `HandsLogic` became a Swift package whose library decides the permission steps against a Privacy fake, and the twelve pytest paths that would raise a real setup window on every run are gone — the twelve that stay never ask the OS for anything. Swift-testing covers what left.

A quieter pattern this week: when something gets removed, the replacement lands first. The library tests before the pytest paths. The migration before the install strip. Removal, when it finally happens, is already redundant.

## Recent Engineering Work

*Updated October 12, 2026*

### Last 24 Hours

- `promptctl/cc-hands` — app: `hands --permissions` decides in a `HandsLogic` Swift library tested against a Privacy fake, with one `privacy.swift` adapter calling macOS; Xcode 16.2 selected for swift-testing ([#293](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/293)); app: the setup window's steps decided in the library and tested against the Privacy fake, with step-by-step grants, Next-after-denial, and a restricted permission stopping the app behind a pending step ([#294](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/294)); tests: the app tests run only paths that draw nothing, so no test puts a window over the person's — twelve window-raising paths removed, twelve kept that exit 0 or quit ([#292](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/292)) ([commits](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/commits?author=brandon-fryslie&since=2026-10-11)).

projects.html: ### [vhid](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid) **Swift · Apache-2.0 · 1★** A virtual keyboard and a virtual mouse for macOS, driven from a CLI or over MCP. Real HID devices through the pqrs DriverKit extension — no event taps, no Accessibility grant. 262 commits over the past month, 78 this week. The human-hands epic kept refining — pointer verbs take a box and press a point drawn inside it, aim held to the hand's line of travel by a Kalman update ([#158](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/158), [#163](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/163)); pointer moves vary like a hand's with overshoot and a bow drawn from the move's seed ([#159](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/159), [#164](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/164)); clicks rest, hold, and space a double-click like a hand ([#151](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/151)); typing comes in bursts with rollover ([#152](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/152), [#156](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/156)); click and key-repeat timings read the HID system's one setting ([#153](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/153)). `eyes` prints each match's box beside its centre, cut to where the system's hit test lands ([#157](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/157), [#160](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/160)); every rectangle it prints takes the `--rect` form ([#162](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/162)); a daemon whose file was replaced refuses to start a reader of another build ([#155](https://github.com/promptctl/vhid/pull/155)). ### [cc-hands](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands) **Python · 1★** Voice for Claude Code — speak to a session over a chord, hear its reply, run a brain that holds its own account on a dedicated Claude Code behind the proxy. 231 commits over the past month, 80 this week. Install one-command landed — one command takes a bare Mac to a running hands, Claude Code's first-run questions and login asked in-line, the plugin installs from a local marketplace in hands' own home so the accept-this-marketplace prompt stops gating an unattended run ([#273](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/273)–[#276](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/276), [#278](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/278), [#282](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/282), [#291](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/291)). `hands.app` runs hands and holds its macOS grants (gated to a live subscription), a setup window asks each permission in turn before hands runs, and the app never asks to be the active app so a launch does not take focus ([#270](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/270), [#271](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/271), [#285](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/285), [#289](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/289)). Today setup decisions moved into a `HandsLogic` Swift package tested against a Privacy fake, and the twelve pytest paths that raised a real setup window on every run are gone ([#292](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/292), [#293](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/293), [#294](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/294)). Raw-api collapse — hands reaches its model only through the brain, keyed Anthropic and OpenAI backends gone ([#268](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-hands/pull/268)). ### [low-talker](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker) **Swift** Local push-to-talk dictation for macOS with a chord-selected command layer. 186 commits over the past month, none this week — the arc has settled. Earlier in the month the streaming arc landed — a press is decoded while the key is down, confirmed words commit while the press is open, dictation stays in the app its first words reached, streamed commits wait for settled punctuation ([#150](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/150)–[#153](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/153)); command mode leaves the code — an utterance becomes one thing, its text at the cursor ([#160](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/160)); a HUD with listening/transcribing, Open at Login, Fn/Globe as the chord ([#161](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/161)–[#168](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/168)); audio under the audible floor answered as nothing said, `verbose_json` serves `avg_logprob` and `compression_ratio`, and an install from huggingface.co records the sizes the hub lists for the revision so a truncated file is fetched again instead of certified ([#169](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/169)–[#171](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/low-talker/pull/171)). ### [rich-js](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js) **TypeScript · MIT** A port of Python's Rich to TypeScript — markup, tables, trees, syntax, progress, tracebacks, Live, and an App runtime that routes focus and the pointer. 156 commits over the past month, 27 this week. The docs card epic landed — static examples became editable cards running in the browser, with output re-rendered client-side, keyboard input, file tabs, slider playgrounds, and edits reaching a running program without restarting it ([#351](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/351)–[#362](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/362)); `/playground` is the card at full width ([#356](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/356)). Byte-for-byte reconciliation with Python's Rich across progress, table, rule, pretty and effects ([#343](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/343), [#344](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/344), [#346](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/346)–[#348](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/348), [#350](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/350)). The effect catalogue — Effected, shimmer, pulse, sparkle, wheel, fade and dissolve — promoted to `src/` with a docs page, and ProgressBar's pulse animates on the library's own clock ([#338](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/338), [#340](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/340)–[#342](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/342), [#345](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/345)); site xterm.js 5.3 → `@xterm/xterm` 6 ([#349](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/rich-js/pull/349)). ### [gh-pages-multiplexer](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer) **TypeScript** GitHub Action + CLI: deploy static sites to versioned subdirectories on gh-pages with auto index page, navigation widget, and PR previews. New repo last week, 65 commits since. Concurrent deploys rebuild from the probed tip instead of rebasing, deploy concurrency is keyed per version slot, token kept out of process args and `.git/config`, publish retries bounded by a 10-minute deadline ([#1](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/1)–[#5](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/5)). The nav widget refreshes in every slot and no second switcher appears inside iframes, storage namespace per slot, PR cleanup correctness ([#6](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/6)–[#11](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/11)); slot names URL-safe by construction, sitemap percent-encoding, canonical URLs stop pointing at 404s ([#12](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/12)–[#14](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/14)); `check:dist` gate on every PR, ref-patterns match the ref name, test git identity isolated ([#15](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/15)–[#19](https://github.com/brandon-fryslie/gh-pages-multiplexer/pull/19)). ### [cc-candybar](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar) **TypeScript · MIT** Powerline statusline for Claude Code — fork of `@owloops/claude-powerline` with CLI override flags so the entire config can live in `settings.json`. 57 commits over the past month, 2 this week as the arc tapered. A live bar on GitHub Pages replays Claude turns, and `pnpm bar:web` opens the live bar in a browser terminal you can click ([#296](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/296), [#297](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/297)). Earlier in the month, menu work — every option setting is `◀ value ▶` opening a plain list, settings marked when they differ from default, the session tab gained `⎘ resume` and `↗ config`, autocompact control, and an alt theme that turns hue every three cells along a row ([#298](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/298), [#300](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/300), [#302](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/302), [#303](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/303), [#306](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/306), [#308](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/308)); the doctor checks that config is correct and the URL handler works ([#311](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/311), [#314](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/314)). This week, a fragment's style reads through the render's theme on rich-js 0.19.0 ([#316](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/316)); a session segment shows the lit ticket being worked, its phase and epic progress ([#317](https://github.com/promptctl/cc-candybar/pull/317)).
